notes.title: Another patch and more news about the demo
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings everybody![/h2]

We have recently published another patch to improve your experience in our demo for Archer: The Witch's Wrath. Check out the changelog below:

[list]
[*] Improved the shop menu, it should no longer be possible to purchase arrows for free after restarting the game
[*] Archer allies AI improved and damage output increased
[*] Added missing SFX to Orc Champion
[*] Added missing sword SFX
[*] Increased game stability
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/263155ff3c2b9c062f127cdd9a20c7b6a0cdb81a.png[/img]

Steam Next Fest is slowly drawing to a close. Thank you for the valuable feedback, we read every comment and took it to heart. This demo is but a small glimpse into the game we want to create and there is a lot of room for improvements and changes. Our main goal when publishing our demo was to establish which game aspects we should focus on or modify. And thanks to your support, we now have all the info we need to create a better game. Thank you!

We will keep the demo public for now, even after the Steam Next Fest ends. If you have any afterthoughts, feel free to share them with us on the forums!

[h3]Happy hunting![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175350/Archer_The_Witchs_Wrath/

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Our World
notes.content:
Our tale begins in a small, secluded village, located somewhere beyond the Shadepass Mountains, near the White Woods. Deep inside the wilderness of the forest, you can find a small village founded near a small trade route. Its inhabitants should enjoy a simple life and live peacefully under the shadow of majestic trees that encompass the settlement. But that is not the case. The village attracted the attention of horrible monsters. Left with no other choice, the villagers ask the player character to aid them in their struggles. 

While the player's quest might start with a simple task of saving a village, the story will continue and take the player into other unique locations. Some will be nearly untouched by men, hidden deep inside the woods where a skilled archer will have good freedom of movement but limited firing angles. Other times, the players will find themselves traversing a dangerous, swampy area where their mobility will be severely reduced. Even in such a hostile environment, the players will need to fend for themselves while being hunted by bloodthirsty beastlikes. 

The journey will also take the player to inhabited locations, such as ancient ruins. There, in the collapsed corridors of an abandoned fortress, the players will lead a group of tattered, desperate soldiers in a battle against overwhelming enemy forces. 

Whether the quest leads the players through snowy mountaintops or dark marshlands, they will always need to be on the lookout for dangers. And that can be a difficult thing to achieve when one finds themselves in such beautiful environments. All we can do is wish you the best of luck. 

Check out the video - https://youtu.be/lgnp5Pmr-jU

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Archery techniques and various arrows
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/161fb4e07b92660b0c213022dcd0d0c22f8ce1be.png[/img]

[h2]Hello archers![/h2]

Phew! It’s been a while since our last devlog! We’d like to catch up and present you with information about recent progress on our game - [b]Archer: The Witch's Wrath[/b]! Our main topic this time will be the archery system.

We have not been dragging our feet when it comes to new features. First of all, we are well aware that archery isn’t limited to one technique. You can use different bows, choose from a variety of arrows, or - obviously - shoot in different ways. We want to give players the freedom of choice; the technique they decide to use will depend on their convenience and needs. The game will give them a chance to experiment with archery, therefore they will learn which style suits them best in practice. We will provide players with opportunities to prove themselves, no matter which path they took.

Speaking about shooting, these are some of the techniques you will be able to learn.

🏹 [b]Basic shot[/b] - the simplest and fastest technique, where accuracy is less important than the rate of fire; it should be used for short or medium distances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/01b4c92a52d4d8678638ab2a1a463b675efceb6f.jpg[/img]

🏹 [b]Double shot[/b] - an alternate version of the basic shot, the difference is that the archer fires two arrows at once; an accurate shot deals double damage, which makes defeating your opponents easier, but on the other hand, player loses arrows faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/9b1798063fe059b0c6eb5721c4e09f487daf7c7a.jpg[/img]

🏹 [b]Precise shot[/b] - this technique is much slower, but makes aiming easier; your character focuses, the camera zooms on the target, and time slows down - in such conditions, the player can shoot more consciously and aim for more vulnerable parts (such as head, which take more damage).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/7ff79fcd1d29bbcfd683813c80554d762e46a6d1.jpg[/img]

🏹 [b]Quick burst[/b] - it is the fastest way to shoot; when aiming, archer focuses (just like with the precise shot), marking up to three targets. Then, three shots are fired at the pointed enemies. Unfortunately, this technique cannot be used constantly, since it has a fairly long cooldown. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/b72439af0379964e95415374bac0c6aa0d6ce473.jpg[/img]

We have mentioned before that shooting techniques will be influenced by arrows. We implemented many types of them in the game. Each will work differently in specific conditions and some will only be useful in exceptional situations. The player can use any type of arrow in each of the techniques we discussed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/703053cba29b459f5c8c244a9279393f209b2f46.png[/img]

🏹 [b]Regular arrow[/b] – an ordinary arrow; deals normal damage to all enemies except armored ones - it does only half the damage to them. 
🏹 [b]Piercing arrow[/b] – a special arrow for monsters with heavy armor; it can penetrate the target, dealing full damage to armored enemies.
🏹 [b]Fire arrow[/b] – deals additional fire damage; there’s also a chance for setting the target on fire.
🏹 [b]Poison arrow[/b] – an arrow that poisons its target, dealing additional damage from poison every second until death.
🏹 [b]Explosive arrow[/b] – it doesn’t have to hit opponents directly; the explosion deals area damage, so it’s best used against groups of enemies. Additionally, there is a chance of knocking down or stunning enemies.
🏹 [b]Magic arrow[/b] – an arrow that allows players to take control over opponents; although the effect wears off after several seconds.
🏹 [b]Wolf arrow[/b] – when fired, this arrow turns into a wolf that charges at your enemies and goes for the throat - it keeps monsters distracted, as they’re focusing on the wolf. The animal will fight to its death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/31631dbd4287fbf5aa728e56cfa4b27004c323dc.jpg[/img]

What do you think? Should we include anything else, to make archery in our game even more immersive? We can’t wait to hear your opinions and suggestions regarding the mechanics described above. 

See you on the next devlog!

[b]Cheers,
Image Power Team[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175350/Archer_The_Witchs_Wrath/

notes.title: Devlog - Weather conditions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/1c4e6829f65a1d2627681d2f2413586ea1f0cc1c.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

[b]Archer: The Witch’s Wrath[/b] is an especially complicated title for us, because we have a lot of ideas how to make interesting and extraordinary. There are lots of changes coming, especially in terms of f in-game mechanics and we would like to share our plans with you. 

[b]The weather[/b]

At the very beginning, when our game was just a concept on a piece of paper, we were planning to have winter as the only season throughout the adventure. However, with time we decided that it will be necessary to add the rest of them as well, in order to avoid repetitive and boring gameplay. We want you to perceive weather like an enemy or a friend - depending on how fast you adapt to the changing conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/00fbf419fff67506c8a2e17699a0e91c82c2620e.jpg[/img]

Rain and wind mechanics are being tested at the moment. They are checked multiple times, so we know that real-life physics work in the game world properly. For example: when it rains, arrows get soaked and fletchings stabilizing their  flight don’t work properly, so it’s much harder to hit the target. Wind affects the arrow's trajectory by altering its speed, so you will have to use arrows of different weight to counter this effect.

Fun fact of the day: did you know that it's better to use fletchings made from water birds’ feathers? It’s because they have specific  type of feathers that protect from moisture and dry way faster.

And don’t worry - there’s much more elements to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/ccfd6a2228cd110487d3013683187996542426a5.jpg[/img]

[b]Think outside the box[/b]

You learned that water and wind can cause problems. It’s hard to aim when the weather conditions are against you, but is there really nothing you can do about it?

🏹 Water makes arrows heavier, so you have to shoot them higher than usual to hit the target.
🏹 Wind may push your arrow in the different direction - you need to learn how to neutralize its impact.
🏹 Sky's the limit, real archers have to deal with such problems by coming up with unusual solutions on their own, so do you (it’s a realistic simulator after all!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/612e09f92763c005b49de4722c7ade3bb5c77ab9.jpg[/img]

[b]Next[/b]
There’s still a lot to talk about, so keep an eye out for our next update on our development progress!

[b]Cheers,
Image Power Team[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175350/Archer_The_Witchs_Wrath/
